purpose: Teach: 河上/金田/稲本/厚木/江崎/宇野/久留米/青葉

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の河上先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — carry on Professor Kawagami's research through your advisor.
lines.style: Measured, declarative opening. Light weight on 'Ren' — attention-getter, not scolding. Steady delivery of the directive. Implicit confidence in Ren's capability, not a question. End with quiet finality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。金田教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Kaneda's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Immediate, respectful affirmation. Slight formality — he's taking the instruction to heart. Quiet determination, not rushed. The words land like a commitment he's writing down in his head as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の稲本先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — consult with Professor Inamoto on the collaborative research.
lines.style: Same measured authority as the first. Direct object follows the name cleanly. No inflection suggesting doubt. The tone of someone who has already thought this through and is now telling Ren the next step.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。神奈川県厚木の研究所と連携します
lines.en: Yes. I'll liaise with the research institute in Atsugi, Kanagawa.
lines.style: Attentive acknowledgment. Slightly more specific than before — he's demonstrating he understands the detail. Steady, matter-of-fact. A young researcher showing he can handle the geography and the logistics without needing it repeated.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の江崎先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — also consult Professor Ezaki's papers in your literature review.
lines.style: Measured instruction, no rush. 'Also' lands lightly — an addition, not a burden. Same authoritative delivery as before. Hiroshi is building a picture for Ren, piece by piece, without impatience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で宇野助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll listen to Assistant Professor Uno's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Quick, deferential agreement. Very slightly more formal than previous responses — maybe he caught something in Hiroshi's tone. No hesitation. The kind of 'yes' that suggests he's already mentally adding this to his to-do list.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、福岡県久留米大学の研究室と連携しろ
lines.en: Ren — connect with the lab at Kurume University in Fukuoka.
lines.style: Still measured, still direct. No fatigue in the delivery — Hiroshi is in his element, giving guidance. The third or fourth instruction lands with the same weight and clarity as the first. A man who knows what he's doing and trusts Ren to follow.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。青葉キャンパスの先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask for guidance from my senior at the Aoba campus.
lines.style: Final affirmation, slightly softer landing than before. He's acknowledged each instruction as it came; now he's closing the loop. Respectful, attentive, showing he's mapped out the network he'll need to tap. Small, genuine note of gratitude in the closing.
